title: lupinus pilosus subsp. cosentinii
intro: Lupinus pilosus subsp. cosentinii, commonly known as the alpine lupin, is a plant species within the lupin genus, native to the mountainous regions of Italy. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of alpine lupin include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lupinus pilosus subsp. cosentinii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
